# Timenon

> Timenon is a confidence-driven Nigerian fashion brand based in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. The brand is built around the philosophy: "Difficult, Not Impossible."

## About

Timenon was founded by Enobong Etim and is inspired by a journey through trauma, isolation, and self-discovery. The brand exists to build confidence through community, activities, and outfits. Customers and members are called "Timenonians."

The name TIMENON is an acronym: T=Trauma, I=Intention, M=Mastery, E=Excellence, N=Neophytism, O=Optimism, N=Narcissism.

## Delivery

- Free delivery within Uyo, Akwa Ibom (1–2 business days)
- Free delivery nationwide on orders over NGN 100,000
- Standard delivery rates for all other Nigerian locations (3–5 business days)
- Payment via Paystack (cards, bank transfer, USSD)

## Programs

- **Ambassador Program**: Ambassadors receive a unique referral code and earn 10% of every order placed with their code, paid monthly.
- **Cashback Program**: Customers who use a valid ambassador referral code at checkout earn 10% of their order as cashback redeemable on future orders.
